POPULATION: National-economy jobs, hours, and wage bill per INDEC CGI-IMO
PERIOD: 2016-Q1 through the latest CGI release retrieved in V1
METRIC: Divergence (in percentage points of YoY growth) between JOB count growth, HOUR aggregate growth, and real WAGE_BILL growth
OPERATIONAL_DEFINITION: Compute YoY growth for each of the three CGI-derived series independently from V1's standardized output; compare pairwise divergence. Real WAGE_BILL requires IPC as deflator (not yet admitted; nominal-only analysis possible now)
EXPECTED_OBSERVATION: Growth rates of JOB, HOUR, and WAGE_BILL diverge by more than 1 percentage point in at least one sub-period
FAILURE_CONDITION: All three series move within 1 percentage point of each other in every observed sub-period
EXPECTED_LINEAGE_DEPENDENCIES: INDEC national-accounts estimation from surveys and administrative records

IPC base December 2016=100; no bridge to earlier base
